# Genuine pre-erasure captures

Generated by `tools/source_module_loader.py` at `VYPER_PIN`, before `get_node`.
No semantic analysis, expression translator or folder is used for capture.
The separately run pinned compiler accepts all five policy regression sources.

| Capture | Sources / canonical keys |
| --- | --- |
| `imported_interface.json` | `../imported_interface/main.vy` (`main`), `../imported_interface/oracle.vyi` (`oracle`) |
| `imported_deploy.json` | `../imported_deploy/main.vy` (`main`), `../imported_deploy/lib.vy` (`lib`) |
| `interface_struct_return.json` | `interface_struct_return/main.vy` (`main`), `interface_struct_return/manager.vyi` (`manager`) |
| `interface_override.json` | `interface_override/main.vy` (`main`), `interface_override/oracle.vyi` (`oracle`), `interface_override/lib.vy` (`lib`) |
| `nonreentrant.json` | `nonreentrant/main.vy` (`main`) |

The struct-return source declarations are identical to the older
`../interface_struct_return/` fixture. Its obsolete `0.5.0a3` version directive
is omitted in the explicitly supplied sources here; the repository pin is a4.
No body/default/annotation is reconstructed from the older annotated JSON.

Create a manifest of `{ "key": [key], "path": source_path }` entries in the
listed order and run the loader with the pinned checkout on `PYTHONPATH`.
Parser module IDs may collide; canonical keys plus the explicit inherited ID
map, not those IDs or diagnostic paths, establish source identities in HOL.

`frontend/sourceModulePolicyTestScript.sml` checks the five captures through
public `Source.check_loaded_contract_result`, pins exact runtime ASTs, retains
original syntax, rejects erased/misaligned policy inputs and fabricated interface
bodies, and checks that nominal field names cannot be invented. The
nonreentrancy capture is checked with the explicit inherited transient lock
entry `(NONE,"$.nonreentrant_key") -> 0`, independently confirmed by the pinned
compiler's layout output; no layout is inferred or fabricated by source loading.
